versions.summary: Register-completeness correction. Mercury tightened 20→15 and soy cadmium 20→10 (Israel FCS-2016, now the strictest applicable formula MLs). Compiler hardened (multilingual canned-gating, powder-scoped reconstitution, read-across as comparator) against a 7× expanded government register.

Initial government-limit standard (Method v2.0): the strictest sovereign maximum by lookup, converted to the as-sold powder basis; read-across for the cells no government regulates the exact product. Mercury 20 (China GB 2762 read-across), Cr-VI controlled via total-Cr + reflex speciation.
